definition_note: A Hormuz-crossing sequence is a resolved liquefaction-to-regasification sequence whose origin is a registered Gulf export project AND whose modeled route transits the strait. This is the hormuz_exposed_leg flag already used by the importer/basin exposure layer. Counting every resolved sequence whose modeled route merely transits Hormuz gives 152 pre-period sequences instead of 145; the seven extra sequences originate outside the registered Gulf export projects (Oman Qalhat, Nigeria, Sabine Pass) and are reported in the non_gulf cohort.
support_note: These are counts of modeled sequences that remain resolvable in the panel. They are not voyage counts, not cargo, and not evidence that unobserved sequences did not occur.
